sections.title: Is the Archer Right for You?

oneLiner: Mobile bow specialist: heavy single-target damage from range, no magic.
howToPlay: Keep your distance and keep moving. Lead with instant shots, keep shooting on the run, and use nets, snares and traps to stop anything that tries to close in. Pick the stance that fits the fight, and stock crafted arrows and traps before you head out.
tips: Let the tank build threat before your big shots.
Stay at range; you're weakest when something reaches you.
Carry plenty of arrows and check your stance before each pull.
Save healing-reduction shots for targets that heal.

oneLiner: The premier healer: plate armor, big heals, resurrection and power over the undead.
howToPlay: Healing is triage: keep the tank up, choose between fast, delayed and absorb heals, and put shields up before the pull. Keep your core self-buff running, become a real damage dealer against undead, and manage mana between fights so the group never waits on you.

Carry and use cures for poison and disease.
Bind your group near the camp, and use your emergency immunity when it's needed.

sections.title: Is the Shaman Right for You?

oneLiner: Spirit healer: slows, debuffs, heals over time and the best physical buffs in the game.
howToPlay: Your work starts before the pull: buff the group, then slow and debuff the mob so the tank takes less damage. Heal ahead of trouble with heals over time rather than catching up after it, add damage-over-time spells, and use Consume to turn health into mana.
tips: Slow first, then heal.
Keep the slow up for the whole fight.
Don't Consume in combat when your health is low.
Keep haste up, and bind your group near the camp.

sections.title: Is the Spellblade Right for You?

oneLiner: Magic swordsman who infuses their weapon and releases it as bursts of spell damage.
howToPlay: There's no fixed rotation. Infuse your weapon with the damage type the fight needs, strike, then release it as a burst with Conduit at the right moment. Teleport behind your target, punish packs with area spells, and drop threat when you overdo it.
tips: Time Conduit; don't fire it the moment it's ready.
Stay behind the mob and keep it in place.
Don't break your group's crowd control.
Keep your defensive ward up.

sections.title: Is the Wizard Right for You?

oneLiner: Pure damage caster with the hardest-hitting spells in the game, and group teleports.
howToPlay: Let the tank build threat, then choose the element: ice to slow, lightning to interrupt, fire for raw damage. The Mark of Magic loop is the heart of the kit. Sit to recover mana between fights, and teleport the group across the world.
tips: Wait for the tank to have aggro before nuking.
Keep area spells away from mezzed mobs.
Don't cast until empty; leave mana for emergencies.
Keep your shields up, and bind near where you're hunting.
